description: ExecutionDomain identifiers registered by BEAP v0.1. Identifiers name a business authority boundary, never a vendor product. Institutions MAY register additional identifiers that follow the same pattern.

entries.description: Creating, verifying, approving, activating, or rejecting a customer relationship.
Creating, approving, activating, or closing accounts and setting their initial limits.
Credit decisions and loan creation up to, but excluding, the release of funds.
Releasing loan funds to a destination account or cancelling a scheduled release.
Servicing changes to an existing credit facility: modification, payment holidays, rescheduling, charge-off, payoff.
Setting, increasing, or decreasing credit limits on a facility or account.
Corporate-initiated payments and payment files, including maker-checker and signatory mandates.
Submitting, releasing, returning, or cancelling individual payment instructions toward posting or clearing.
Institution-side liquidity, internal, and settlement transfers.
Changes to an existing customer record, status, or classification.
Changes to an existing account: beneficiaries, mandates, limits, freezes.
Institutional configuration: product parameters, fee schedules, rates, privileges.
